notes: Reply 1: the question ('Does it matter to you where your doctor did their postgraduate training?') is genuine and neutral, but abstract. Most readers don't know where their own doctor trained, so few will answer it from experience. Every other check is strong: the cover carries '12' and 'a First for IITs' over IIT Kharagpur's Main Building; NEET-PG candidates have a reason to forward it (Round 2 choices lock 15 Nov, 11:55 pm); the specialities, seat count and dates are worth keeping; the first-IIT and Round 2 claims are attributed to officials via PTI; each slide names IIT Kharagpur.
